meta.title: HELOC Calculator | Achieve-style demo
meta.description: Estimate available equity, monthly interest or amortizing payment on a draw, remaining equity, and LTV / CLTV. Sample rates are illustrative only.

header.title: HELOC calculator
header.intro: Estimate available equity, monthly interest or amortizing payment on a draw, remaining equity, and LTV / CLTV. Variable-rate APR is labeled illustrative only.

demoBanner.strong: Sample / demo only — not an offer.
demoBanner.body: Rates and limits are illustrative estimates for education and UX prototyping. Actual HELOC APRs are often variable; eligibility, credit limits, and payments depend on lender underwriting.

mortgageBalance.label: Mortgage balance (optional)
mortgageBalance.hint: Current first-lien balance. Leave 0 if none.

maxCltv.label: Max combined LTV for credit limit
maxCltv.hint: Demo default 85% CLTV cap used to derive available equity / credit limit.

creditLimit.label: Available equity / credit limit
creditLimit.hint: Derived as max(0, home value × max CLTV − mortgage). Edit to override until home / mortgage / CLTV change.

drawAmount.label: Draw amount
drawAmount.hint: Amount drawn from the HELOC line for this estimate.

apr.label: APR (variable-rate, illustrative)
apr.hint: Sample / demo only — not an offer. Real HELOC rates are often variable.

payMode.hint: Interest-only: monthly interest on the draw. Amortizing: fixed P&I from day one (Achieve-style fixed-rate line). Draw, then repay: interest-only during the draw period, then P&I over the repayment period.

term.hintInterestOnly: Shown for context on interest-only; monthly payment is interest on the draw only.
term.hintAmortizing: Fixed principal & interest over this many years on the draw amount.

repayYears.label: Repayment period
repayYears.hint: Principal & interest after the draw period ends.

creditBand.label: Credit score range
creditBand.hint: Sets the illustrative margin added to the prime rate. Edit APR directly to override.

results.heading: Your estimate

modeLabels.drawRepay: Draw {{draw}} yr IO, then {{repay}} yr P&I

results.invalidMessage: Fix the highlighted fields to see an estimate.
results.unableMessage: Unable to calculate with these inputs.
results.summaryInterestOnly: Sample / demo only — not an offer. {{modeLabel}} · IO period {{years}} yr (context){{limitNote}}
results.summaryAmortizing: Sample / demo only — not an offer. {{modeLabel}} · {{months}} payments{{limitNote}}
results.summaryDrawRepay: Sample / demo only — not an offer. {{modeLabel}}{{limitNote}}

cta.label: Explore home equity options
cta.note: Placeholder CTA — not a live application or rate quote.

footer.note: HELOC estimates are demo-only. LTV = mortgage ÷ home value; CLTV = (mortgage + draw) ÷ home value. Remaining equity here = home value − mortgage − draw (simplified). Not a loan offer or compliance guarantee.

validationMessages.drawExceedsLimit: Draw amount cannot exceed the credit limit.
validationMessages.mortgageExceedsHome: Mortgage balance cannot exceed home value.
